value.description: We immerse ourselves in your celebration with gentle, unobtrusive movement. We never shout directions, freeze sacred rituals, or manufacture artificial poses.

value.tagline: Painterly Warmth Tailored for Indian Ceremonies
value.description: No harsh digital oversaturation or orange skin tones. Our bespoke film emulation reproduces true silk textures, rich marigold garlands, and radiant Indian skin tones.
value.craftFocus: Kodak Portra & Fuji 400H emulation • 14-bit RAW dynamic range • Custom color curves

value.title: Museum-Grade Archival Longevity
value.description: Your photographs are not meant to live solely on a phone screen. We craft custom-bound Italian leather and linen albums printed on 100% acid-free cotton rag.
value.craftFocus: 310gsm German cotton paper • Lay-flat panoramic spreads • 100-year fade resistance

value.bio: Founding YOU & ME with a devotion to emotional authenticity and fine-art elegance, Brinta oversees the artistic vision of every wedding commission. With an instinct for quiet intimacy, cinematic framing, and decisive gestures, he crafts photographs that feel like living poetry.
value.favoriteQuote: Photography is the pause button of life.

value.question: What is your photography style?
value.answer: We specialize in documentary-style photography, capturing genuine, candid moments as they happen. We also provide gentle guidance for beautiful portraits of the couple and family.

value.question: Do you travel for weddings?
value.answer: Yes! We are available for destination weddings and love to travel. Please contact us for a custom quote that includes travel.

value.question: Do you work with a second shooter?
value.answer: Most of our packages include a second photographer to ensure we capture every angle and moment of your day.

value.question: How do we book you?
value.answer: First, check our availability by filling out our contact form. To reserve your date, we require a signed contract and a retainer fee.

value.question: When should we book?
value.answer: We recommend booking 9-18 months in advance, especially for popular dates, as they tend to fill up quickly.

value.question: How many photos will we receive?
value.answer: Clients can expect to receive between 100-125 professionally edited and unlimited lightroom edited images. We do not put a limit to your dream wedding.

value.question: How will we receive our photos?
value.answer: Your high-resolution images will be delivered via a private online gallery within 2-3 weeks of your wedding date. From the gallery, you can easily download, share, and order prints.

value.question: Do we get printing rights?
value.answer: Yes, all our packages include a print release, giving you the freedom to print your photos for personal use.
